name: Seibu Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Seibu Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells mechatronics in Japan. The company operates through Conveyor Machine, Industrial Machinery, and Precision Machinery Business Segments. Its products include conveying machinery, such as automated storage warehouse, automatic case picking system, robotics and material handling, piece picking system, and FA system; actuator, valve actuator, and gate drive device; electrical discharge machine, ultra-precision, high-precision wire electrical discharge machine; machine tool, comprising High-precision compact NC lathe and grinding machine.
